stock_ue3_semantics (not WFC-proven).bSmoothFrameRate: UEngine: clamp/smooth the game frame rate between Min/MaxSmoothedFrameRate (UGameEngine::GetMaxTickRate)
stock_ue3_semantics (not WFC-proven).MinSmoothedFrameRate: UEngine: lower bound of the smoothed tick rate (Hz)
stock_ue3_semantics (not WFC-proven).MaxSmoothedFrameRate: UEngine: upper bound of the smoothed tick rate (Hz) - effectively the frame cap when smoothing is on
stock_ue3_semantics (not WFC-proven).MinDesiredFrameRate: UEngine: target used by detail/LOD scaling (e.g. particle / distance scaling), not a cap
stock_ue3_semantics (not WFC-proven).OneFrameThreadLag: render thread may lag the game thread by one frame
stock_ue3_semantics (not WFC-proven).MaximumPIEFrameRate: editor Play-In-Editor cap (not used by the game)

pc_adaptation_note: Original Xbox 360 game: smoothed tick between 15 and 30 Hz (30 fps target). Any PC frame limiter above 30 fps (e.g. 60 / 120 / 144 / uncapped) is a PC ADAPTATION; gameplay code that assumed <= 30 Hz ticks (fixed-step physics, animation, timers) should be checked under higher rates.
